OUR SERVICES

Digital Marketing &
IT Services in Dubai, UAE

Sham Marianas is a Dubai-based digital marketing and IT agency helping UAE businesses
grow through SEO, paid media, branding, web development, social media and AI automation.

01
Branding Design

Creative Identity

For startups and established UAE businesses, we create logos, visual identities and brand guidelines that make your company memorable and consistent across every touchpoint.

02
UI-UX Design

User Experience

We design clear, user-friendly interfaces for UAE websites and digital products, including wireframes, prototypes and responsive designs that improve usability and conversions.

03
Web Development

Innovative Solutions

We build fast corporate websites, landing pages and custom web platforms for Dubai businesses, with responsive development, CMS integration and SEO-ready structure.

04
E-Commerce Solutions

Seamless Shopping

We create online stores for UAE brands with product setup, payment integration, mobile-friendly layouts and conversion-focused shopping journeys.

05
Content Writing

SEO-Optimized Content

We write SEO content, website copy, service pages and blogs that match how UAE customers search, helping businesses build authority and attract relevant visitors.

06
Product Design

User-Centric Design

We help startups and growing businesses turn ideas into practical digital products through research, user flows, prototypes and interface design.

07

Brand Growth

FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

Useful answers about choosing and working with Sham Marianas.

01Why should I choose Sham Marianas?+

We combine digital marketing, branding, design and technology under one team. Our strategies are tailored to each business, supported by research and focused on clear, measurable outcomes.

02Which service is right for my business?+

That depends on your goals, audience and current challenges. We review your business first, then recommend the right combination of services instead of offering a one-size-fits-all package.

03Do you provide SEO and Google Ads?+

Yes. We provide technical SEO, local SEO, SEO content, Google Ads and performance reporting to help businesses attract relevant traffic and qualified enquiries.

04Do you build websites and e-commerce stores?+

Yes. We build corporate websites, landing pages and e-commerce stores with responsive layouts, CMS or platform integration, payment setup and SEO-ready structure.

05Do you work with businesses outside the UAE?+

Yes. We work with businesses in the UAE, Pakistan and other international markets. Projects can be managed remotely with clear communication and regular updates.

06How do you measure marketing results?+

We agree on measurable goals at the beginning of a project and track relevant metrics such as search visibility, website traffic, leads, enquiries, conversions and campaign performance.

07How do I start a project with Sham Marianas?+

Contact us through the enquiry form or WhatsApp. We start with a conversation about your goals, audience, budget and timeline, then recommend the most suitable next steps.
